page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is built on x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. It provides 24 dedicated virtual CPUs without hardware GPU acceleration, delivering stable processing capacity for compute-heavy workloads requiring dedicated execution threads.

The hardware configuration provides 48.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Local storage is not included with this instance, requiring external network-attached volumes for data persistence and filesystem operations. Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with the instance.

The compute-centric profile of ecs.c8i.6xlarge emphasizes processing density over memory capacity, reducing overhead for CPU-bound tasks. Without local scratch disks or GPU resources, the configuration targets tasks requiring sustained multi-core compute throughput and network traffic handling. Appropriate workloads include batch data processing, distributed worker nodes, continuous integration and build pipelines, media transcoding, and scalable web serving tiers.
